_comment: Pre-registration for the Renewable Headwind Model's project part (docs/headwind_model.md). Committed before any fit; a change after the first fit is appended to amendments with its date and reason, never an edit in place. Only descriptive counts of data/reference/queue_projects.csv (requests by request year and status) had been looked at when this was written.
requested_by: Price, 2026-11-20: keep building the predictive model, named the Renewable Headwind Model.

amendments.change: Adds a second label, withdrawn_3y, fit and reported beside the registered label, which stays primary. Frame: requests made 2010 to 2022 in grid regions where at least 90% of withdrawn requests carry a withdrawal date (data through 2025, so every request has at least three years of follow-up). Positive: withdrawn within 1,096 days of the request. Every other request in the frame is 0, whether it is active, suspended, operational or withdrew later. Out of time: fit on requests made 2010 to 2018, scored on 2019 to 2022. Same variables, method and promotion rule.
amendments.reason: The first fit showed that only 134 of the 6,742 resolved requests made 2010 to 2019 sat in a county with a severe rule dated before the request, because most dated local rules come from 2020 on. The registered frame cannot test rules it barely contains. A fixed-horizon label reaches requests made through 2022 without dropping the ones still active. It was chosen after seeing the first result, so the report labels it as added after the first fit.

frame.rows: requests whose technology includes solar, wind or battery_storage, not offshore, with a county_fips and a request_date in 2010 to 2019
frame.resolved: status withdrawn with a withdrawn_date, or status operational with an operational_date; active, suspended and unknown requests are left out of the fit and counted in the report
frame.why_2010_2019: requests made in 2020 or later are still mostly active, and the ones already resolved are mostly quick withdrawals, which would bias the label

label.name: withdrawn
label.caution: A withdrawal is not opposition. Most withdrawals have market or grid reasons. The label is the outcome the county's record is set beside, not a measure of opposition.

snapshot.as_of: 1 January of the request year: only facts dated in earlier years enter a request's row
snapshot.restriction_year: year of date_enacted_iso, else the first four-digit year in date_text (scripts/county_labels.py year_of); an undated restriction never counts as before
snapshot.technology_match: a restriction counts for a request when they share a technology
snapshot.touches: every county in a restriction's county_fips_all

base._comment: Always in the model. They describe the request and its market, not the county's record.

variables.severe_before: 1 when the county has a severity 3 or 4 restriction on the request's technology dated before the request year
variables.standards_before: 1 when the county has a severity 1 or 2 restriction on the request's technology dated before the request year
variables.undated_rule: 1 when the county has a restriction on the request's technology with no year (it cannot be placed before or after the request)
variables.neighbor_severe_share: share of adjacent counties with a severity 3 or 4 restriction on any technology dated before the request year
variables.prior_withdrawal_share: smoothed share of the county's earlier requests that had withdrawn before this request's date, among those resolved before it: (withdrawn + 5 * 0.8) / (resolved + 5)
variables.log1p_prior_requests: log of 1 + the county's requests made before this request's date
variables.log1p_operating_mw: log of 1 + solar and wind MW operating in the county at the end of the year before the request year (data/reference/facilities.csv)
variables.log_density: log population density, ACS 2020-2024 (static; leakage class none)
variables.pct_bachelors_plus: share of adults with a bachelor's degree or more, ACS 2020-2024 (static)
variables.margin: Republican minus Democratic two-party margin, 2016 presidential (the earliest in the covariates)

method.model: L2 logistic regression on standardized variables (scikit-learn), as scripts/county_restriction_model.py
method.variable_rule: the data center rule registered 2026-08-26: a county variable stays only if its coefficient keeps its sign on all 25 folds; the least stable is dropped one at a time; base variables are never dropped
method.comparison: the base model alone, on the same folds; the headwind variables earn their place only by the gain in out-of-fold AUC over it
method.state_grouped: five folds grouped by state, reported beside the stratified result
method.out_of_time: fit on requests made 2010 to 2016, scored on requests made 2017 to 2019
method.gate: scripts/calibration_gate.py on the cross-fitted recalibrated out-of-fold score
method.promote: the gate says PROMOTE and the headwind variables add at least 0.01 AUC over the base model, both stratified and out of time

secondary.name: contested_blocked
secondary.frame: contested projects in data/processed/contested_projects.csv with outcome blocked_confirmed or advanced_confirmed, a county and a year (resolution_date, else the first year in event_date_text)
secondary.use: scored with the primary model's county variables as of the project's year; reported as a check only, never fit on its own while it has under 200 cases
